BRAND IDENTITY / PORTFOLIO PROJECT

Unlock Moment

A compact visual identity designed to carry across merchandise, signage and promotional media.

DESIGNER / ODUSINA ISAACDISCIPLINE / BRAND IDENTITYVIEW THE PROJECT GALLERY ↓

Context

The project explores a brand mark across personal items, public signage and promotional formats.

Visual direction

A red shield shaped symbol pairs with a black wordmark. White surfaces and a repeated diagonal shadow treatment connect the mockups.

Design decisions

The compact emblem works on the cap, hoodie and travel mug. Larger applications combine the emblem with the wordmark and red panels.

Applications

Nineteen design presentations include merchandise, ID cards, signage, a vehicle and promotional screens.
